bill.title: Watershed districts, watershed management organizations, and towns permission to self-insure for certain employee health benefits

posted_text:
💧 MN SF 3887 — Local Governments Could Now Self-Insure for Employee Health Benefits

Minnesota local governments – including watershed districts and towns – could soon have more options for employee health coverage.

This bill would allow these entities with over 100 employees to establish self-insurance plans for benefits like long-term disability, but not life insurance.

The plans would need to meet state Department of Commerce standards and be certified before implementation.

Importantly, the bill also outlines a process for consulting with exclusive employee representatives if a local government considers dissolving a self-insurance trust fund, ensuring continued coverage for employees.

This change would primarily affect local government employees and the agencies that provide them with health benefits.

Aug. 1, 2026: Effective date.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/bill.php?b=Senate&f=SF3887&ssn=0&y=2025
